summary: iter428 My Vehicles module — comprehensive backend + frontend testing complete. All 7 backend pytest cases pass against the live preview URL. Frontend module renders on /vehicle-dashboard for testdealer@bidvex.com with all data-testids, correct disabled states per spec, working tab filters, and functional retire dialog. No React error #31 or crashes observed. Bilingual labels render (French by default per dealer's preferred_language). Duplicate + retire full workflows exercised end-to-end.

issues: Orange banner 'Frais annuels de plateforme requis — Payer maintenant — 100$/an' is unrelated to My Vehicles but occupies significant space above the module (existing behavior — not new).

critical_code_review_comments: MyVehiclesModule.jsx hard-codes English/French strings (isFr ternaries) instead of using t('vehicleListings.*') keys. The review request explicitly requires 'Bilingual via existing localization files'. Localization files were reportedly extended with keys (retiredTab, duplicate, retire, etc.) but the module does not consume them. Recommend replacing all `isFr ? 'FR' : 'EN'` with t() calls so translations are centralized and can be updated without JSX edits.

Duplicate endpoint copies is_demo, category, media, and every source field including winner_id — while winner_id is explicitly reset, no explicit reset for potential eligible_provinces/fees; low risk since drafts are re-editable, but explicit reset would be safer.

Duplicate endpoint enforces monthly limit but does NOT re-validate QC bilingual title or category rules — a duplicate could be published later without going through /api/vehicles/{id}/activate compliance checks. Verify activate path re-checks Bill 96.
Retire endpoint has no audit log (log_audit) call — most other status transitions log audit entries. Consider adding for traceability.
